Foursquare OS Places
--------------------
The Foursquare OS Places dataset (the "Data") is licensed under the Apache
License, Version 2.0 (the "License"); you may not use, modify, or distribute
the Data except in compliance with the License. You may obtain a copy of the
License at http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0.

Rahat reads the Data into its gazetteer (core/kb/gazetteer.py) through
scripts/food_gazetteer.py and keeps this NOTICE with it, as the License and
Foursquare's notice (https://opensource.foursquare.com/places-notice-txt/) ask.
Attribution to Foursquare is preserved on every fact that comes from the Data
(source "Foursquare OS Places").
